$comment: The extras of omx-suboct's declaration: what its descriptor, omx-suboct.descriptor.json, has no word for (docs/declaration-as-descriptor.md). The two are the folder's hand-written files; tools/gen.mjs generates the rest and writes the travels the descriptor's links resolve to. Its parameters are by reference to omx-contract's suboct kernel and bind by name to omx-dsp's instance face. Control order, the descriptor's, is append-only.

panel.$comment: TODO: family none: it has no shift control (the octaves are fixed, each a level) so the pitch family is not backed; it waits for the utility family or an octave-divider family, then declares it.

console.$comment: The OpenMixer console has no sub-octaver stage. Racked as a plugin in a channel's insert rack, it is drawn by the generic plugin editor.
